K00.keys: Never rendered: the static .controls panel from index.html that js/20-mixer-layout.js does not re-parent stays in the DOM with display:none (prep/baseline/dom/NOTES.md, surface overlay:.controls). No keyboard road, none intended.

K01.keys: Container, not focusable (.sidebar-section, .mixer-channel, role=group, role=radiogroup); its controls carry the keyboard.

K02.keys: role=status, role=alert, role=note: announced, not interactive.

K03.keys: Native <label>: not focusable; a click forwards to its control (for= or wrapping).

K11.keys: Native <button> with aria-pressed: Enter / Space toggle; aria-pressed follows the class (24 writers in js/, e.g. js/20-mixer-layout.js buildColorChannel).

K12.keys: Native <button> with aria-haspopup / aria-expanded: Enter / Space open the panel; opened from the keyboard, focus moves into it, Tab out closes it, Esc closes it, focus returns to the button (DialogFocus.popup, js/00b-dialog-focus.js:190-231; Presets js/20-mixer-layout.js:2243; Invite / room menu js/06e-mp-panel.js:807; More js/46-strip-more.js:215).

K13.keys: button.qub-dd-btn[aria-haspopup=listbox]: Enter / Space toggle the list, ArrowUp / ArrowDown open it, Esc closes it (js/20-mixer-layout.js:2867-2881); the list is K3A.

K14.keys: .skip-menu-option: Space / Enter move focus into the region, the arrows jump to the region they point at, Home / End, Esc puts focus back where it came from; other keys never reach the hotkeys (js/66-skip-menu.js:252-278).

K15.keys: button.arm-tip-btn[aria-haspopup=menu]: Enter / Space open the arm-tip menu (js/20-mixer-layout.js:8901-8914); focus lands on the active option (798); Esc closes and returns focus to the square (694-701). The menu is K55.

K16.keys: button.lsb-toggle / .rsb-toggle with aria-expanded: Enter / Space fold or unfold the bar (js/20-mixer-layout.js:2406, 2545).

K20.keys: input[type=range]: ArrowLeft / ArrowDown and ArrowRight / ArrowUp move at least 1% of the travel, Shift+arrow 10%, snapped to the slider's step (js/67-slider-keys.js:24-60); PageUp / PageDown, Home and End are the browser's.

K21.keys: input[type=checkbox] (role=switch included): Space toggles; its label forwards clicks.

K22.keys: input / select with aria-hidden="true" and tabindex="-1": the state holder behind a proxy, out of the Tab order (strip colour chips: #randomColor / #stepPalette / #colorGate, js/20-mixer-layout.js buildColorChannel; quality bar selects: js/20-mixer-layout.js:2820-2822; #mutationScope). The keyboard reaches the proxy, not this element.

K23.keys: input[type=radio]: arrows move within the group, Space selects.

K24.keys: input[type=number]: ArrowUp / ArrowDown step, typed digits, Enter commits.

K25.keys: input[type=text] / <textarea>: typing; app hotkeys are suspended while it has focus (js/01a-param-registry.js isTypingTarget).

K26.keys: input[type=color]: a click (Enter / Space on the focused well) is intercepted in the capture phase and opens the shared picker popover instead of the OS dialog (js/64-colour-picker.js:720-729 → openFor 612). The popover is K3D / K52-K54.

K27.keys: input[type=file]: Enter / Space open the OS file picker.

K28.keys: <select>: ArrowUp / ArrowDown change the value, Alt+ArrowDown / Enter / Space open the list, type-ahead.

K30.keys: span.section-title[role=button][tabindex=0]: Enter / Space toggle the section, with Shift additive so the accordion keeps the others open (js/20-mixer-layout.js:9326-9339); aria-expanded follows the .collapsed class and the title catches focus when its section folds under it (9340-9351).

K31.keys: .ch-ignite-lock[role=button][tabindex=0]: Enter / Space toggle the latch (js/20-mixer-layout.js:1488-1497); aria-pressed follows .latched (1498-1501).

K32.keys: #paletteSelect[role=combobox][tabindex=0]: Enter / Space / ArrowDown / ArrowUp open the palette listbox (js/01-config.js:456-462); in the list ArrowDown / ArrowUp / Home / End move, Enter / Space choose (618-621), Esc closes, Tab closes and walks on (544-558); Menu key / right-click open rename / duplicate / delete (463-466).

K33.keys: .palette-chip[role=button]: one chip in the Tab order (roving tabindex, js/01-config.js:945-948); ArrowLeft / ArrowRight / ArrowUp / ArrowDown, Home, End move along the row, Enter / Space paint with it (949-969); Menu key / Shift+F10 open the chip menu (contextmenu, 906-910).

K34.keys: span.fx-thumb[role=img][tabindex=0]: focus shows the effect card, blur hides it; Enter / Space click the effect's checkbox (js/20-mixer-layout.js:4441-4451). A focusable role=img that acts as a button (see Open questions).

K35.keys: canvas#ditherPad[role=application][tabindex=0]: the arrows move the cursor square (wrapping), Space / Enter flip it (js/68-dither.js:322-337); the aria-label says so.

K36.keys: button[role=radio] in .brush-mode-row[role=radiogroup]: ArrowLeft / ArrowRight / ArrowUp / ArrowDown move the choice and focus (js/20-mixer-layout.js:5737-5749); Enter / Space are the native click; ~ steps the type too (js/59-brush-type-key.js:95).
